name: contract-management-service
description: CargoDesk's third extracted microservice — owns contracts/contract_legs/contract_rates/contract_routings as a standalone alternative to the monolith's own in-process implementation, selected at runtime via the app_settings.contract_source toggle (local|remote). Called only by the monolith (routes/contracts.js's remote branch), never by the browser directly. Migrated to Postgres (ARCHITECTURE.md §13, Phase 4) — see lib/db.js. Resolved dependencies (express, pg, @electric-sql/pglite) are hoisted from the repo root's node_modules — no separate install step.
